title: The Private room of the house
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：private　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 private 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the builder wrote of ① a private room of the house in the plan, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② so private that nobody in the site would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the builder, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the private ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the private room of the house that anybody there had ever seen, or so the plan for October 1969 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too private to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the private ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a private talk in the kitchen, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as private as the talk in the kitchen they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was private or not, and he said so.

By 1982 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was ⑦ something private, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite private; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the plan kept the names of the private ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1985, in the rain, she wrote of another private room of the house in the same plan, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less private than anybody had expected. ⑩ The private talk in the kitchen that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1987, was the one she could never quite name; the private ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 私人（前置定语 a private room of the house：1975 年施工员在施工图里记下的那件私人的私室）
B. adj. 私人／私下（两处加强说法：so private that … 与 no less private than …）
C. adj. 私人／私下（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 私人（表语 too private to do：母亲觉得它太私人，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 私下（前置定语 a private talk in the kitchen：叔叔把整件事称作一桩私下的谈话）
F. adj. 私下（同级比较 as private as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩厨房里的私下谈话相比）
G. adj. 私下（后置定语 something private：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 私下（受程度副词修饰 quite private：那位帮工的评价）

items.q: a private room of the house
the private room of the house that
a private talk in the kitchen
The private talk in the kitchen that

answers.why: private 意为“私人”，1975 年施工员在施工图里记下的是“一件私人的私室”，此处作前置定语 a private room of the house。
private 意为“私人”，此处用 so private that 结构，说它私人到工地里没人敢靠近。
private 意为“私人”，施工图上 十月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的私人屋里的私室，等于最高级的说法。
private 意为“私人”，母亲认为这件东西“太私人了，谁也用不上”，too private to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
private 意为“私下”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩私下的谈话”，此处作前置定语 a private talk in the kitchen。
private 意为“私下”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩厨房里的私下谈话一样私下”，同级比较用 as private as。
private 意为“私下”，施工图上那半行字要的是“私下的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something private。
private 意为“私下”，邻工地来的那位帮工认为这套计划“相当私下”，quite 修饰原级 private。
private 意为“私下”，no less private than 表示“其私下不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之私下不亚于任何人的预料。
private 意为“私下”，母亲 1987 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的私下谈话”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1975 年，施工员在施工图里记下了一件私人的私室。（a private room of the house）
它私人到工地里没有一个人敢靠近。（so private that …）
母亲觉得它太私人，谁也用不上。（too private to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩私下的谈话。（a private talk in the kitchen）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩厨房里的私下谈话一样私下。（as private as …）
到了 1982 年，施工图上只剩半行字：要的是一件私下的东西。（something private）
answers: In 1975 the builder wrote of a private room of the house in the plan.
It was so private that nobody in the site would go near it.
My mother thought it too private to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a private talk in the kitchen.
He said nobody would call it as private as the talk in the kitchen they had once had.
By 1982 the plan asked for nothing but something private.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 private 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the builder wrote of a private room of the house in the plan, and nobody forgot it.
It was the private room of the house that anybody there had ever seen, or so the plan says.
My mother thought it too private to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a private talk in the kitchen, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next site called the plan quite private, and everybody laughed.
The private ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
